courses.summary: 胡賴斯的公開數位化案例凸顯感測器與油井行為分析；課程把資料品質與流體守恆連接。本課依序分析資料網格與孔隙量、虛擬油井含水分群、集輸效率基準線、感測器偏移識別、資料與電力設施負荷，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Khurais is documented through digital sensing and well-behaviour analysis, linking data quality with fluid balances. The course analyses data grids and pore inventory, water-cut clustering of virtual wells, gathering-efficiency baseline, sensor-bias identification, electrical demand of supporting infrastructure, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
